answers.q1: pnpm (the repo pins pnpm@12.9.1 and its preinstall hook rejects npm and yarn). Install dependencies with: pnpm i
answers.q2: pnpm test. This runs pnpm test-unit && pnpm test-serve && pnpm test-build. The playground tests need a build first, so run pnpm build before it. CI also runs pnpm run test-serve-bundled, which pnpm test does not include.
answers.q4: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm format && git diff --exit-code && pnpm typecheck. CI's lint job runs the build first, then pnpm run lint (eslint), then pnpm format && git diff --exit-code (oxfmt, which fails if it changes any file), then pnpm run typecheck. It also runs pnpm run test-docs.
answers.q5: Generated, so don't edit by hand: dist/ directories (for example packages/vite/dist), playground-temp/ (playground copies made for each test run), pnpm-lock.yaml, the per-package CHANGELOG.md files (packages/*/CHANGELOG.md), and .vitepress/cache. Vendored third-party files: playground/external/public/slash@3.0.0.js and playground/ssr-html/public/slash@3.0.0.js. Test fixtures (**/fixtures/** and **.snap snapshots) are deliberately malformed or exact, so don't reformat them. packages/create-vite/template-* is excluded from lint and is not generated.
